policy_text_full: Newegg offers a 7-day price adjustment when Newegg's own price drops after purchase. Refund is issued as store credit or original tender. Marketplace third-party listings and open-box items are excluded.
policy_text_relevant_clause: Within 7 days of purchase, customers can request a price adjustment if Newegg's own price drops; marketplace sellers and open-box items are excluded.
